# PRD V0.2 local Golden fixtures

These three files are manually authored local Host-Agent-shaped fixtures. Tests pass them through the real deterministic `assemble_prd` and `archive_prd_candidate` path.

They prove output-contract and archive compatibility only. They are not authenticated installed Host Agent executions, external product review, release evidence, or real-business quality evidence. Stage 2 default activation must continue to report authenticated Host status as `NOT_RUN` until separately executed and verified.
